善语结善缘（善语结善缘（第22页）“嗯，咱们两个一起。”
“这些东西，等到公墟和火耀结束修炼之后，交给他们。”
“少主，我现在修为不弱，我跟着可以帮忙的。”
确实，王霸自从跟着陈长安之后，修为突飞猛进，如今其实是他们四个之中，修为最高的。
陈长安是一等鸿蒙极尊，牧云谣和大黄是三等，唯有王霸突破到了五等。
只不过相对而言，他的战力并没有陈长安他们三个那么变态罢了，但也绝对是天才级别，甚至可以达到妖孽的程度。
“我知道你现在也很厉害，能够帮到我们。”
“可我们都走了，圣巫一族的人又不是我们去做了什么，容易着急。”
“你留下来，可以将我们的去向告诉他们。”
“你的努力我都看在眼里，你很棒。”
听到陈长安的话，王霸这才笑了起来，重重的点了点头，道“少主放心，我绝对不会让你失望的。”
“那我留在这里，你们放心去忙。”
说罢，陈长安便带着牧云谣向着天宫秘境深处飞去。
“长安，那个入口，我能进去吗？”
“其实上一次我就看出来了，那个入口虽然是可以将很多人拦住，但不是一定进不去。”
“还记得我说过，那入口后面有两个看守者吗？”
“他们其实就有能力让人通过那个入口。”
“到时候我先进去，然后让这两个人放你进来。”
两人一路没有任何惊险的来到了入口处，陈长安对着牧云谣点了点头，便直接进入到了入口之中。
看到陈长安突然出现，那两个看守者也愣住了。
“虽说过去了这么多年，但是……”
虽说已经过去了有段时日了，陈长安这修炼的时间虽然并不算长，但也过去了一百多年。
对于很多人而言，这一百多年不算什么，尤其是这种级别的修炼者。
可是陈长安的修为，却让他们不得不震惊一下了。
“不是，这才过去多少年，你的修为怎么提升的这么快？”
看到两人震惊的样子，陈长安笑着说道“很快吗？我觉得还行吧。”
“都修炼这么多年了，才提升到一等鸿蒙极尊境，哎，我都怕丢人。”
听到陈长安的话，这两人恨不得直接把陈长安生吞了，有这么装逼的吗？太特么气人了。
“你过来不会就是为了跟我们两个炫耀的吧？”
“如果是，那么很不高兴的通知你，你特么做到了。”
“哎呀，也算是相识一场，何必这样呢，恶语伤人心。”
“拉倒吧，我们可不愿意跟你有什么牵扯，还不知道是福是祸呢。”
“行吧，那你们帮我把这个入口打开一下，我老婆在外面进不来。”

Kind words lead to good karma (Kind words lead to good karma) (p. 22) "Well, let's go together."
"These things will be handed over to Gongxu and Huoyao after they finish their training."
"Young Master, my cultivation is not weak now. I can help if you follow me."
Indeed, Wang Ba's cultivation has improved by leaps and bounds since he followed Chen Changan, and now he is actually the one with the highest cultivation among the four of them.
Chen Changan is the first-level Hongmeng Supreme Master, Mu Yunyao and Dahuang are the third-level, and only Wang Ba has broken through to the fifth level.
It's just that relatively speaking, his combat power is not as abnormal as Chen Changan and the three of them, but he is definitely at the level of a genius, and can even reach the level of a monster.
"I know you are very powerful now and can help us."
"But we're all gone. It's not like we did anything for the Holy Witch clan, so they tend to get anxious easily."
"You stay and you can tell them where we are going."
"I see all your hard work, you are great."
After hearing Chen Changan's words, Wang Ba laughed, nodded heavily, and said, "Don't worry, young master, I will never let you down."
"Then I'll stay here and you can go about your business without worries."
After saying that, Chen Changan took Mu Yunyao and flew towards the depths of the secret realm of Tiangong.
"Chang'an, that entrance, can I go in?"
"Actually, I saw it last time. Although the entrance can block many people, it doesn't necessarily mean they can't get in."
"Remember what I said about the two watchers behind that entrance?"
"They actually have the ability to get people through that entrance."
"I'll go in first then, and then ask these two people to let you in."
The two of them arrived at the entrance without any danger. Chen Changan nodded to Mu Yunyao and entered directly.
Seeing Chen Changan's sudden appearance, the two watchmen were also stunned.
"Although so many years have passed, but..."
Although some time has passed, and although Chen Changan's cultivation time is not long, more than a hundred years have passed.
To many people, these more than a hundred years are nothing, especially practitioners of this level.
But Chen Changan's cultivation level shocked them.
"No, it's only been a few years, how come your cultivation level has improved so quickly?"
Seeing the shocked looks of the two people, Chen Changan smiled and said, "Is it going to be fast? I think it's okay."
"After practicing for so many years, I have only been promoted to the first-level Hongmeng Supreme Realm. Hey, I'm afraid of being embarrassed."
After hearing Chen Changan's words, these two people wanted to eat Chen Changan alive. Are they so pretentious? So infuriating.
"You didn't come here just to show off to the two of us, right?"
"If so, I'm very unhappy to inform you that you did it."
"Oh, it's just an acquaintance. Why bother? Bad words hurt people's hearts."
"Pull him down. We don't want to have anything to do with you. We don't know if it's a blessing or a curse."
"Okay, then help me open this entrance. My wife is outside and can't get in."
